hero.description: Professional loading and unloading labour across Delhi NCR. Trained workers, proper equipment, available 7 days a week. Book labour only, or combine with our transport vehicles for a complete solution.

features.title: Trained Labour Team
features.desc: Experienced loading and unloading workers for all types of goods — fragile, heavy, or bulk.

features.title: All Goods Types
features.desc: Household items, factory goods, office equipment, retail stock, and industrial machinery.

features.title: Equipment Available
features.desc: Trolleys, straps, padding, and lifting equipment for safe and efficient handling.

features.title: With or Without Vehicle
features.desc: Book labour only, or combine with our Chota Hathi / Bolero Pickup for a complete solution.

features.title: Same-Day Availability
features.desc: Urgent loading-unloading teams available on short notice across Delhi NCR.

features.title: Safe Goods Handling
features.desc: Careful handling with proper padding and securing to ensure goods are transported safely.

features.title: Affordable Rates
features.desc: Hourly and per-trip pricing. Written quotes before every booking, no hidden charges.

features.title: Pan Delhi NCR
features.desc: Loading and unloading services across Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad.

usecases_sub: Our loading and unloading teams handle all types of goods for businesses and individuals.

usecases.title: Factory & Warehouse
usecases.desc: Bulk goods loading from factory floors and warehouse docks.

usecases.title: Retail & Shop Shifting
usecases.desc: Shop inventory loading, shifting, and unloading at new premises.

usecases.title: Office Relocation
usecases.desc: Furniture, IT equipment, and office supplies handled with care.

usecases.title: Household Shifting
usecases.desc: Home goods, appliances, and furniture loaded and unloaded safely.

usecases.title: E-commerce Fulfilment
usecases.desc: Bulk stock unloading at fulfilment centres and warehouses.

usecases.title: Construction Materials
usecases.desc: Heavy materials, tiles, cement, and equipment loading at sites.
